hypotheses.reasoning: The notif-db data volume filled up on its own: usage went 93% (#125) → 96% (#178) → 99% (#213) as WAL/binlog grew about 700–800MB/h. At 09:50:31 InnoDB hit 'No space left on device' writing notifications.ibd (#227, #246, #250). After that, notification-svc inserts failed with error 1114 'table is full' (#230, #239, #256), and api-gateway passed these on as 500s on POST /v1/notify. Reads still work because only writes need disk. There are no deploy logs. The audit_log slow query (#211) and the TLS certificate warning (#65) don't explain the failures.
Some gateway 500s took a long time (6–28s), and there was one slow seq-scan query. But the actual failures are disk-full write errors, not timeouts.

verdict.recommendedAction: Free up space on notif-db /var/lib/mysql right away by purging or archiving old binlogs (PURGE BINARY LOGS, set binlog_expire_logs_seconds) or by growing the volume. Then check that inserts work again. Find out why binlog/WAL is growing so fast (a replica lagging, or retention set wrong), and add alerts on disk-growth rate.
